stories.story_fr: BAT a ajoute 4,7 millions de consommateurs de marques Smokeless en 2025 pour atteindre 34,1 millions, le Smokeless representant desormais 18,2% du revenu du Groupe, en hausse de 70 points de base sur un an.
stories.story_en: BAT added 4.7 million Smokeless brand consumers in 2025 to reach 34.1 million, with Smokeless now 18.2% of Group revenue, up 70 basis points year on year.
stories.quote: Added 4.7 million consumers (to 34.1 million) of our Smokeless brands ... Smokeless products now 18.2% of Group revenue, up 70 bps vs FY24

stories.story_fr: La contribution categorielle des New Categories a bondi de 77,1% a 442 millions de livres en 2025, illustrant le passage des nouvelles categories a une rentabilite croissante via l'approche Quality Growth.
stories.story_en: New Categories category contribution surged 77.1% to GBP 442 million in 2025, marking the shift of new categories toward rising profitability via the Quality Growth approach.
stories.quote: New Categories contribution increased by 77.1% to £442 million, driven by our Quality Growth approach

stories.story_fr: Velo Plus a livre une croissance de revenu a triple chiffre aux Etats-Unis, le Modern Oral y bondissant de 310% a 327 millions de livres, Velo atteignant la 2e position en part de volume et de valeur et la rentabilite en moins d'un an.
stories.story_en: Velo Plus delivered triple-digit U.S. revenue growth, with Modern Oral up 310% to GBP 327 million, Velo reaching the number 2 position in volume and value share and profitability within one year.
stories.signal: Velo Plus US croissance triple chiffre
stories.quote: Velo Plus has delivered excellent results with triple-digit revenue growth, with Velo reaching the number 2 position in volume and value share and achieving category contribution profitability within one year of launch ... Modern Oral up 310% to £327 million

stories.story_fr: Vuse est revenu a la croissance de revenu au second semestre 2025 aux Etats-Unis, soutenu par un renforcement de l'application de la reglementation au niveau federal et des Etats face au commerce illicite.
stories.story_en: Vuse returned to revenue growth in H2 2025 in the U.S., supported by stronger enforcement at the Federal and State level against illicit trade.
stories.quote: encouraging signs for Vuse with the brand back to revenue growth in the second half of 2025 in the U.S. supported by increased enforcement at a Federal and State level

stories.story_fr: Les capacites R&D renforcees ont permis trois lancements d'innovation premium en 2025 (Vuse Ultra, glo Hilo et Velo Shift) avec des resultats encourageants et des deploiements cibles supplementaires prevus en 2026.
stories.story_en: Enhanced R&D capabilities enabled three premium innovation launches in 2025 (Vuse Ultra, glo Hilo and Velo Shift) with encouraging early results and further targeted roll-outs planned in 2026.
stories.quote: Our enhanced R&D capabilities have enabled three premium innovation launches - Vuse Ultra, glo Hilo and Velo Shift, with encouraging early results and further targeted roll-outs planned in 2026

stories.story_fr: Des l'exercice 2024, BAT progressait vers un monde Smokeless avec 3,6 millions de consommateurs supplementaires a 29,1 millions et une contribution categorielle en hausse de 251 millions de livres.
stories.story_en: Already in fiscal 2024, BAT was progressing toward a Smokeless world with 3.6 million more consumers to 29.1 million and category contribution up GBP 251 million.
stories.quote: Consumers of Smokeless* products up 3.6m to 29.1m ... £251m increase in Category contribution
